svg.title: A rectangle of height three split into widths x and two
svg.desc: A rectangle has height 3 cm and total area 21 square centimetres. A vertical line splits its width into x cm on the left and 2 cm on the right. Both parts have height 3 cm. Schematic, not to scale.

g.text: Schematic, not to scale. How does each part contribute to the whole?
